per_attempt.primary: Wait, it ends here? Have you ever blurted that out when a manga ends at an exciting moment and says the story will continue next time? What will that character say next? What will happen to the two of them? It might be a shame to let those ideas stay only in your head. The company that runs LINE Manga has announced the launch of Bias, an AI story chat service. It is pronounced Bias. You can enjoy talking with your favorite characters and make your own stories based on the works. You can take a step from the reader's seat onto the stage of storymaking. If you thought, can't you already talk with characters? You've noticed something important. LINE Manga already has character chat. The company says the difference is that, as well as having conversations, you can make stories more freely. In other words, you can enjoy not only asking, what should we talk about next, but also, what should happen next?
